items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: The same one George Lewis played? Yeah. George learned that from them.

ctx.x: A number he used to play that's Buegel Boy in March. That was the famous number on the street during them days. The same one George Lewis played? Yeah. George learned that from them. That's a good number too. Right? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's a good number. That's a good number. Yeah.
It's a good number. You say he had a big tone loud.
